title: Emeralds Plus Default Texture Pack
description: This is the Default Texture Pack of The Emeralds Plus Mod.
body:
# 🖼️ The Emeralds Plus Mods default Texture Pack

The Emeralds Plus Mods default Texture Pack lets you change the textures of the [Emeralds Plus Mod](https://modrinth.com/mods/emeraldsplus).
You can use it if you want to change the mod textures.It Includes **Every** Texture and texture files of the mod version.Its neccesary to install the mod,otherwise the texture pack will do nothing

---
